agent.name: Team Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Bounded contextual adoption action and reversal conditions

analytical_question: Answer all five supplied NYU syllabus-checking questions with reasoning, preserving the three-level distinction and the present action versus expansion gates.
general_et_finding: Q2: C. General business GenAI is leading edge by classroom assumption. This does not establish syllabus-review fitness. Program A/B posture does not change that general finding. Current vendor performance and comparable diffusion are not provided.
application_finding: Q1: B. Higher-education administrative support for syllabus checklist review. The task flags omissions and identifies passages; it does not assess student learning or produce course content. Compare required-element detection, false alarms, passage fidelity and total checking/correction effort against manual and template/rules baselines.
organization_specific_finding: Q3: A. The hypothetical approved environment, permitted documents and retained staff authority support a bounded pilot direction, conditional on a funded protocol and accountable owner. Q4: D. A may pilot; B defers its live trial until independent application results satisfy its explicit gate. This is a difference in authorization and uncertainty tolerance, not general maturity.

evidence.claim: Approved environment, permitted documents, human approval and absent local comparative evidence; A/B trial authorization differs.
evidence.source_or_reference: source_questions.txt, supplied Questions for your agents(1).pdf
evidence.notes: Not actual NYU policy, measured pilot results or verified current technology-market facts.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Advocate: bounded learning may resolve the value gap promptly. Risk officer: false negatives and review costs may defeat the value hypothesis; reviewer effectiveness must be evaluated.
Vendor growth, novelty, sunk effort and excessive caution cannot replace application evidence.
Staff approval reduces exposure but does not demonstrate accurate checking or adequate review capacity.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in these conditional classroom distinctions; low confidence in real deployment readiness. No local results, monetary budget, approved quantitative targets or actual NYU authorization are supplied.
value_opportunity_implication: Q5: B. Representative results meeting agreed quality and net time-saving targets against manual review would support staged expansion with review and rollback. This is a hypothetical evidence criterion, not an assertion that tests already passed.
risk_governance_implication: Retain staff final approval, evidence passages and rollback. Investigate review capacity, training, operating ownership, incentives and candid reporting through Organizational Adoption; do not certify readiness or legal compliance.
recommendation_management_implication: BOUNDED_EXPERIMENT: Propose a four-week supervised shadow comparison for the base case and Program A, not university-wide adoption. Before execution confirm program-review lead, document permissions, approval and cost budget. Proposed exposure cap: 30 permitted syllabi and 40 staff-hours, plus an approved monetary cap; these are management proposals. Stratify by program, complexity and missing/ambiguous elements; adjudicate reference labels independently. Measure recall of critical requirements, false positives, supporting-passage fidelity and total staff time including correction versus manual review and a simpler rules/template alternative. Proposed continuation gates: no critical missed requirements, at least manual quality and 20% lower median total effort; staff must agree targets before testing. Log AI/staff disagreements and document/model drift. Stop for critical misses, unsupported passages, permission breaches, ineffective review or cap overrun. Review at week four; repair/retest or reject the design if quality or comparative value fails. A workflow experiment is preferred over a narrow technical PoC because comparative usefulness is uncertain. Program B: DEFER its live trial; the proposed program lead reviews independent application evidence in four weeks and requests explicit authorization only after the gate is met. No production deployment follows automatically.
change_monitoring_triggers: At week four compare representative quality and total effort with pre-agreed manual-baseline targets; passing permits consideration of a separately approved staged expansion.
Program B reopens a live-trial decision only after relevant independent application results satisfy its stated gate and trial approval is given.
Loss of data permission, review effectiveness or containment pauses the activity; inspect root cause and independently review repair before retesting.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Confirm pilot owner, approved budget and quality thresholds before execution.
Need representative local task-group results, full review-time accounting and rollout/rollback evidence before expansion.
Abstain from university-wide deployment or actual NYU policy conclusions.
